import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0017 (a b c : ℝ) (h : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) (x : ℝ) : a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0017 (a b c : ℝ) (h : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) (x : ℝ) : a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
  have h1 : 2 * a * x * x + 2 * b * x + b^2 - 4 * a * c > b^2 - 4 * a * c := by
    calc
      2 * a * x * x + 2 * b * x + b^2 - 4 * a * c = (2 * a * x + b) * (x - (b / (2 * a))) + b^2 - 4 * a * c : by ring
      _ > b^2 - 4 * a * c : by linarith [h]
  have h2 : (2 * a * x + b) * (x - (b / (2 * a))) > 0 := by
    have : 2 * a * x + b ≠ 0 := by
      rwa [ne.def, not_and_distrib, not_or_distrib, not_not] at h1
    · linarith [h1]
    · linarith [h1]
  exact h2
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0017 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0017 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0017

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0017
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0017
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
